value.name: recognize Devin's decision
value.description: Asha realizes Devin has already done the arithmetic and is deciding what version of Monday morning to give her.
evidence: she understood that he had already done the arithmetic on his own and was now trying to decide which version of Monday morning he was going to hand back to her
whatever he chose she had given up the standing to argue with

value.name: lower briefcase and hold Devin's gaze
value.description: Asha lowers her briefcase slightly and fixes Devin with an unblinking stare instead of softening her stance.
evidence: Asha let the briefcase slide an inch lower in her grip
She kept her eyes on Devin's and did not blink
she did not reach for any of the softening clauses she had practiced on the stairs

value.name: withhold help from Devin
value.description: Asha decides not to help Devin answer and instead gives him space to decide on his own.
evidence: she had given up the right to help him answer
the only thing left to offer him was the time to decide without her shaping it

value.name: let briefcase settle at her side
value.description: Asha relaxes her grip enough for the briefcase to rest against her thigh as she waits in the doorway.
evidence: Asha let the briefcase settle against her thigh
she only let her weight find the floor and stay there

value.name: clear space for Devin's response
value.description: Asha holds her position in the doorway so Devin's next words must enter a space she has left open.
evidence: whatever Devin said next would have to come into a space she had already cleared for it

value.name: wait for Devin to speak
value.description: Asha watches Devin's face and waits silently for his answer without shaping her own expression.
evidence: she watched his face without arranging hers
